# MCP tools reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.mjs from server/agent.js — do not edit by hand. -->

The board serves these tools at `POST /mcp` (MCP Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC 2.0). Every answer is short
Hebrew text meant to be read by the agent; dates and times are resolved by the server. Each agent sees only its
person's spaces. In the descriptions, "the user" is replaced with the person's name for each agent.

| Tool | What it is for |
| --- | --- |
| [`board`](#board) | START HERE for anything time- or agenda-related. |
| [`find_tasks`](#find-tasks) | Search tasks; returns one short line per task (id, title, status, project, dates, people, steps, active reminders with their ids). |
| [`create_tasks`](#create-tasks) | Create one or more tasks in one call (each filed into a project + status — you sort, the user does not). |
| [`update_tasks`](#update-tasks) | Change one or more tasks in one call; each item is applied atomically and reported separately. |
| [`remind`](#remind) | Set, move (snooze) or cancel a task reminder; Workboard itself sends it to WhatsApp at that time. |
| [`focus`](#focus) | The user has free time ("יש לי שעה פנויה", "על מה כדאי לעבוד?") → their open tasks of one work type, ranked by what is most worth doing now, each with the reasons and the next step. |
| [`projects`](#projects) | List projects, or create/update one (name, aliases, goal, due date, color, archive). |
| [`calendar`](#calendar) | The user's schedule (לו״ז): meetings and blocked work time they told you about, day by day, with each item's reminder, plus the FREE gaps (08:00–18:00) so you can suggest when something fits. |
| [`add_events`](#add-events) | Add items to the user's schedule — "קבעתי דיון עם X ביום Y בשעה Z", "שמתי מחר 13:00–13:45 זמן עבודה על המצגת". |
| [`update_events`](#update-events) | Move, change or cancel schedule items by id (ids from calendar/board). |
| [`shopping`](#shopping) | The household shopping lists — all shared with the partner (both of you and both agents see them): super (supermarket, grouped by department — the default), pharm (pharmacy: medicine, cosmetics, hygiene), house (general things for the home that fit no shop: shelves, tiles, tools, furniture), personal (things one of you needs for themselves — each item shows who added it), wish (what each of you would like one day; shows who added it — "what does she want?" = the partner's wishes). |
| [`history`](#history) | Recent changes (who/what/when), each with an activity id for undo. |
| [`undo`](#undo) | Undo a change by activity id (from history or from a previous tool result). |

## `board`

START HERE for anything time- or agenda-related. Returns in one short text: the current local date/time, the next 8 days with weekday names, statuses, projects (with aliases/goals), today's agenda (overdue / due today / planned today / carried over / follow-ups / in progress / later this week), and the reminders sent to WhatsApp in the last hours — when the user answers briefly ("עוד שעה", "בוצע", "לקחתי"), they are almost always replying to the latest of those. Use it instead of running `date`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recent_hours` | integer |  | How far back to list sent reminders (default 6). |

## `find_tasks`

Search tasks; returns one short line per task (id, title, status, project, dates, people, steps, active reminders with their ids). Set detail=true for steps/notes/all reminders (best with ≤5 results). Without filters returns all open tasks.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string |  | Free text over title/notes/steps/tags/people, or "#12" / "12" for an id. |
| `ids` | array of integer |  | Exact tasks (found even if done/archived); other filters still apply. |
| `status` | string |  | Status id/label; comma separated for several. |
| `project` | string |  |  |
| `with` | string |  | Person name (matches the "עם מי" field and text). |
| `due` | `overdue` · `today` · `week` |  |  |
| `kind` | `solo` · `together` · `coord` · `followup` · `none` |  | Work type; "none" = not classified yet. |
| `space` | string |  | work \| personal \| home. Default: all your spaces. |
| `include_done` | boolean |  | Also completed tasks. |
| `include_archived` | boolean |  | Also archived tasks. |
| `detail` | boolean |  | Steps, notes, fields, reminders. Notes are complete when ≤3 results. |
| `limit` | integer |  |  |
| `offset` | integer |  | For paging through long results. |

## `create_tasks`

Create one or more tasks in one call (each filed into a project + status — you sort, the user does not). Each result line says what was created, with resolved dates, or the error for that item. Warns about likely duplicates of open tasks — check before creating twice.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tasks` | array of objects | yes |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `title` | string | yes |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `space` | string |  | Where the task lives: work (default for new tasks), personal (private life: health, family, errands, hobbies), home (shared household with your partner: repairs, bills, kids, house). Moving a task between spaces is allowed. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `assignee` | string |  | Home tasks only — whose it is: me, partner, both, or none (unassigned). Default for a new home task: me. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `project` | string |  | Project id, name or alias. "none" to clear. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `status` | string |  | Status id or label (e.g. next/doing/waiting/someday/done or Hebrew label). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `priority` | string |  | urgent \| high \| normal \| low |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `when` | string |  | Planned work day. Date words are resolved by the server in local time: YYYY-MM-DD, today/היום, tomorrow/מחר, next-workday, a weekday (sun…thu or ראשון…חמישי = the coming one, never today), next-week (= coming Sunday), end-of-week (= Thursday), +3d, +2w, DD.MM, or "none" to clear. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `deadline` | string |  | Hard due date (תג״ב). Date words are resolved by the server in local time: YYYY-MM-DD, today/היום, tomorrow/מחר, next-workday, a weekday (sun…thu or ראשון…חמישי = the coming one, never today), next-week (= coming Sunday), end-of-week (= Thursday), +3d, +2w, DD.MM, or "none" to clear. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `with` | string |  | People involved (the "עם מי" field), comma separated. "" to clear. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `kind` | `solo` · `together` · `coord` · `followup` |  | Work type — set it on EVERY task: solo = hands-on work the user does alone; together = hands-on but needs someone; coord = a call/meeting/arranging something with someone; followup = someone else does it, the user checks. "" clears. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `effort` | string |  | Rough effort if the user said it or it is obvious: 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 8h (or רבע שעה/חצי שעה/שעה/חצי יום/יום ומעלה). Empty string clears. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `fields` | object |  | Other custom fields by id or label, e.g. {"קישור": "https://…"}. "" clears one. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `tags` | array of string |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `notes` | string |  | Replaces the notes. Prefer append_note. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `append_note` | string |  | Adds a line to the notes. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `steps` | array of string |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `remind` | object |  |  |

## `remind`

Set, move (snooze) or cancel a task reminder; Workboard itself sends it to WhatsApp at that time. Moving: pass reminder_id, or "latest" for the reminder that fired most recently on that task — never add a second reminder when the user asks to postpone one. Without reminder_id a new reminder is added. Works on reminders that already fired.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task` | integer | yes |  |
| `at` | string |  | Reminder time, resolved by the server in local time: +90m, +2h, +1h30m, 17:00 (today; tomorrow if already past), "tomorrow 09:30", "ראשון 09:30", "next-workday morning" (morning=09:00, noon=12:00, evening=18:00), or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. |
| `reminder_id` | string |  | r… id from find_tasks/board, or "latest". |
| `note` | string |  |  |
| `repeat` | `daily` · `weekdays` · `weekly` · `monthly` |  |  |
| `nag` | integer / null |  |  |
| `cancel` | boolean |  | Delete the reminder (needs reminder_id). |

## `focus`

The user has free time ("יש לי שעה פנויה", "על מה כדאי לעבוד?") → their open tasks of one work type, ranked by what is most worth doing now, each with the reasons and the next step. Same ranking as the dashboard's "זמן פנוי" page. mode solo = hands-on alone (default); coord = calls/coordination he can close in a few minutes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space` | string |  | work \| personal \| home; default all. |
| `mode` | `solo` · `coord` · `together` |  |  |
| `minutes` | integer |  | How much time the user has (יש לי חצי שעה = 30): only tasks estimated to fit; unestimated ones come after. |
| `limit` | integer |  |  |

## `projects`

List projects, or create/update one (name, aliases, goal, due date, color, archive). Use it when a recurring topic needs a project, or to add an alias so future matching works. Removing projects is not possible here — ask the user.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `upsert` | object |  |  |

## `calendar`

The user's schedule (לו״ז): meetings and blocked work time they told you about, day by day, with each item's reminder, plus the FREE gaps (08:00–18:00) so you can suggest when something fits. Default: today and the next 6 days.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string |  | Date words are resolved by the server in local time: YYYY-MM-DD, today/היום, tomorrow/מחר, next-workday, a weekday (sun…thu or ראשון…חמישי = the coming one, never today), next-week (= coming Sunday), end-of-week (= Thursday), +3d, +2w, DD.MM, or "none" to clear. |
| `days` | integer |  |  |

## `add_events`

Add items to the user's schedule — "קבעתי דיון עם X ביום Y בשעה Z", "שמתי מחר 13:00–13:45 זמן עבודה על המצגת". Workboard reminds them on WhatsApp before each one (default: meeting 15 min, work block 10 min; set remind_before when he asks for something else). Link work blocks to their task. Do NOT also create task reminders for the same thing. Warns about overlaps.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `events` | array of objects | yes |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `title` | string |  | Defaults to the linked task's title. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `at` | string |  | Start as one phrase: "מחר 11:00", "ראשון ב-9:30", "2026-10-20T14:30". Reminder time, resolved by the server in local time: +90m, +2h, +1h30m, 17:00 (today; tomorrow if already past), "tomorrow 09:30", "ראשון 09:30", "next-workday morning" (morning=09:00, noon=12:00, evening=18:00), or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `date` | string |  | Or the day separately. Date words are resolved by the server in local time: YYYY-MM-DD, today/היום, tomorrow/מחר, next-workday, a weekday (sun…thu or ראשון…חמישי = the coming one, never today), next-week (= coming Sunday), end-of-week (= Thursday), +3d, +2w, DD.MM, or "none" to clear. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `start` | string |  | HH:MM (with date). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `end` | string |  | HH:MM end time. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `minutes` | integer |  | Or the length instead of end. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `kind` | `meeting` · `work` · `other` |  | meeting = a discussion/meeting with people; work = time the user blocked to work on something ("חלון עבודה", "זמן לעבוד על…"). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `task` | integer |  | Link to the task this is about (a work block for task #12, the meeting a coordination task set up). |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `with` | string |  | People attending. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `location` | string |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `notes` | string |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `space` | string |  | work (default) \| personal (a doctor, a haircut, friends) \| home (household). A linked task's space is used when omitted; shared:true means home. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `shared` | boolean |  | A household item for both partners (technician visit, family dinner): shows on both schedules and reminds both. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `remind_before` | integer |  | Minutes before start for the WhatsApp heads-up. Omit for the default (meeting 15, work 10); -1 = no reminder. |

## `shopping`

The household shopping lists — all shared with the partner (both of you and both agents see them): super (supermarket, grouped by department — the default), pharm (pharmacy: medicine, cosmetics, hygiene), house (general things for the home that fit no shop: shelves, tiles, tools, furniture), personal (things one of you needs for themselves — each item shows who added it), wish (what each of you would like one day; shows who added it — "what does she want?" = the partner's wishes). `claim` a wish the partner added to quietly mark "I'll buy this" — the one who wished never sees it. Add many items in one call; duplicates merge. check / uncheck / remove by id or words; finish=true clears ticked items of `list`. Returns the list(s) asked about.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list` | `super` · `pharm` · `house` · `personal` · `wish` |  | Default list for add/finish and which list to show. Default super. |
| `add` | array of objects |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `text` | string | yes |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `list` | `super` · `pharm` · `house` · `personal` · `wish` |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `qty` | string |  | e.g. "2", "1 ק״ג", "גדול" |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `note` | string |  | Brand, size, link, price… |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `dept` | `produce` · `dairy` · `bakery` · `meat` · `deli` · `frozen` · `pantry` · `spices` · `snacks` · `drinks` · `cleaning` · `pharm` · `baby` · `home` · `other` |  |  |
| `check` | array of string |  | Bought: ids (s…) or item words. |
| `uncheck` | array of string |  |  |
| `remove` | array of string |  |  |
| `move` | array of objects |  | Fix a supermarket department (remembered) or move an item to another list. |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `item` | string | yes |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `dept` | `produce` · `dairy` · `bakery` · `meat` · `deli` · `frozen` · `pantry` · `spices` · `snacks` · `drinks` · `cleaning` · `pharm` · `baby` · `home` · `other` |  |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `list` | `super` · `pharm` · `house` · `personal` · `wish` |  |  |
| `claim` | array of string |  | Wishes the partner added that the user will buy as a gift (hidden from the partner). |
| `unclaim` | array of string |  |  |
| `finish` | boolean |  |  |
| `all` | boolean |  | Show every list instead of one. |

## `history`

Recent changes (who/what/when), each with an activity id for undo. Optionally for one task.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task` | integer |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  |  |

## `undo`

Undo a change by activity id (from history or from a previous tool result). Fails with a conflict if the same field changed since.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activity_id` | string | yes |  |
